name: phrasely
description: An AI-powered companion for understanding, exploring, saving, retrieving, and practising English phrases from real life.

interface.shortDescription: Turn real-life English into active vocabulary.
interface.longDescription: Understand expressions in context, turn rough notes into memorable entries, save them naturally, and practise them later with your private Phrasely collection.
defaultPrompt: Explain this English expression and its nuance.
Make this phrase memorable, then save it.
Quiz me using phrases from my collection.
